title: Haye kya kare zainab
body:
HAYE KYA KARE ZAINAB HAYE KYA KARE ZAINAB, ARBAEEN BHAYI KA KIS TARHA KARE ZAINAB
KHAID SE REHA HOKAR KARBALA MEIN AAYI HAI, QHAAFELA YATEEMAON KA APNE SAATH LAAYI HAI, YA ALI MADAD KI JIYE MUNHARIF KHUDAYEE HAI, ARBAEEN BHAYI KA KISTARHA KARE ZAINAB, HAYE KYA KARE ZAINAB HAYE KYA KARE ZAINAB
KARBALA MEIN YE PEHLA ARBAEEN KA MATAM HAI, FARSH HAI NA SAYA HAI BEKASI KA AALAM HAI, GOONJTA HUA NOUHA HAR TARAF YE PAIHAM HAI, ARBAEEN BHAYI KA KISTARHA KARE ZAINAB, HAYE KYA KARE ZAINAB HAYE KYA KARE ZAINAB
BEKASI HAI GHURBAT HAI GHAM SE GHAIR HAALAT HAI, HOULNAAK SEHRA HAI AUR DASHTE GHURBAT HAI, JALTI DHOOP MEIN AB TAK SHAHE DEEN KI TURBAT HAI, ARBAEEN BHAYI KA KISTARHA KARE ZAINAB, HAYE KYA KARE ZAINAB HAYE KYA KARE ZAINAB
<<DIVIDER>>
PAI BA PAI NAYE SADME KIS QHADAR SAHE ZAINAB, DARD-O-GHAM KE AALAM MEIN KAB TALAK RAHE ZAINAB, CHUP RAHE KE DARD-E-DIL BHAYI SE KAHE ZAINAB, ARBAEEN BHAYI KA KISTARHA KARE ZAINAB, HAYE KYA KARE ZAINAB HAYE KYA KARE ZAINAB
QASIM-O-ALI AKBAR HAI NA SAATH HAIN ABBAS, SIRF EK ABID KE KOI BHI NAHIN HAI PAAS, DIL HILAYE DETA HAI YE JUDAYI KA EHSAAS, ARBAEEN BHAYI KA KISTARHA KARE ZAINAB, HAYE KYA KARE ZAINAB HAYE KYA KARE ZAINAB
ARZOO-E-ZAINAB KA KAR RAHEIN HAI HUM SAMAAN, AAJ HAI HASAN GHAR GHAR CHEHLUME SHAHE ZEESHAN, HAQ ADA HO ZAINAB KA YE QHAYAL HAI HAR AAN, ARBAEEN BHAYI KA KISTARHA KARE ZAINAB, HAYE KYA KARE ZAINAB HAYE KYA KARE ZAINAB..
